Baijavāpa
authority on dh. Ment. in Aparārka, Hāralatā an. Smṛticandrikā, see Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1198a.
--Baijavāpagṛhyasūtra. q. v.
--Baijavāpasmṛti. q. v. [Page099-b]

Baijavāpa(pi)gṛhyasūtra
Āśval. Ment. by Mahāyaśas in Gobhilaśrāddhakalpabhāṣya, Weber 322; by Hemādri in Pariśeṣakhaṇḍa sn. of Caturvargacintāmaṇi (
); by Kumārila Bhaṭṭa in Tantravārttika, (See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1078); by Raghunandana in Śrāddhatattva; by Bhaṭṭa Siddheśvara in Sam3skāramayūkha,

.
Reconstructed text for ed. by Bhagavaddatta. See Proceed. AIOC. IV. ii. p.. 59-67.

Baijavāpapariśiṣṭa
on adbhutaśānti. Q. often by Ballālasena in Adbhutasāgara. Pt.. Calcutta, 1905.

Baijavāpasmṛti
ment. by Mādhavācārya in C. on Parāśarasmṛti,

b; by Aparārka, Hemādri an. Raghunandana, see Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1078b.
Kavīndrācārya 643.

Baijavāpāyana
Q. by Mahāyaśas in his C. on Gobhilīyaśrāddhakalpa, Weber 322; ment. by Hemādri in Caturvargacintāmani, see Kane, HDS. I. p.. 596b. 1078b an. in Pariśeṣakhaṇḍa.

Baijā
or Vaijā.
See Vaidyanātha, a of C. on Jyotiṣaratnamālā of Śrīpati.

Baiji
Ancient authority on gr. ment. in Vākyapadīya. See Belvelkar, Systems of Skt. Gr. p. 41.

Baijūka
ins. poet. a. of ins. of Muhamūd Sultan Nasiru-d-din Mahmud of the [Page100-a. Slave dynastay; composed in 1328 A. D.
Ed. by Hiralal, Epi. Ind. XX. p. 46. See Epi. Ind. XIX. p. 97.
